title: WhatsApp invitation 404 fixed on the live website
summary: Published the missing invitation page and supporting assets to lecomax.com. All three public URLs now return HTTP 200 and match the tested source.

changes.detail: Published three missing assets on the exact 1664-file prior production source. Existing build 20 links can open the landing page without a new APK. Vercel deployment dpl_3gzo3edEzp9CB14dxpMij944zteM promoted successfully using explicit project team.

validation.name: Focused regressions
validation.detail: Nine landing/internet-flow tests passed, including strict payload handling, app targets, consent gating, Arabic and clipboard fallback.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Vercel Ready; compilation, type checks and 249 static pages completed. Existing repository lint warnings remain.

validation.name: Staged and public verification
validation.detail: All three staged assets matched local source byte-for-byte. After promotion all three public assets returned 200 and exact expected content; DOM checks confirmed Android payload and Arabic RTL.

validation.name: Physical phones and separate internet mode
validation.detail: Actual WhatsApp-to-Android launch and two-phone screen capture remain untested. The pictured Tailscale mode still requires Learn and Tailscale on both phones. Separate no-Tailscale relay/backend was not deployed. New history is saved locally for a future app build.
